preconditions.description: The number of tree nodes n must be an odd integer between 3 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(parent, int) and (parent == -1 or 1 <= parent <= n) for parent in parents)
preconditions.description: Each node's parent must be either -1 for the root or a valid node index between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(key, int) and 1 <= key <= 10**9 for key in keys)
preconditions.description: All node keys and search keys must be positive integers not exceeding 1 billion.
The number of search keys k must be between 1 and 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly k real numbers corresponding to the expectations for each search key.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(float(value) - expected_value) <= 1e-9 for value, expected_value in zip(map(float, stdout.split()), expected_values))
postconditions.description: Each output value must be within an absolute or relative error of 10^-9 from the expected value.
